t: This is Ministry of Sound, a British entertainment business based in London. It began as a nightclub, and the group now also runs a shared workspace, a private members' club, a worldwide events operation, a music publishing business and a fitness studio. It was founded by two people. James Palumbo is a businessman who now sits in the House of Lords as Baron Palumbo of Southwark. Justin Berkmann is a DJ and nightclub owner who is also named as a founder.
